About the event

Strange Exchange is a library and community learning space in the East End of Glasgow. We share publications and other resources related to arts education from across Scotland, the UK and further afield.


We are open every Thursday and Saturday 11am - 4pm. 

The library is on the second floor of the Strange Field container space on Moncur Street, opposite the Pipe Factory. We are wheelchair accessible via the lift and the space includes an accessible and gender neutral toilet. 

There is space to browse the collection, a scanner, wifi access, heating, tables to work and comfortable seating, as well as a small kitchen with a kettle, microwave and access to tea and coffee. Children and young people are welcome. We have a small (but growing) collection of books built around them.
Assistance animals are also welcome.
